positions.as_written: Check the peroneal nerve in every corner injury.
Assess the posterior cruciate in every corner injury and the corner in every posterior cruciate injury.
Document peroneal nerve function at presentation.
Treat the corner as the structure that sets rotational position.
Assess alignment before planning a corner reconstruction.
Stage the corner before any cruciate reconstruction in a knee with lateral findings, because an unrecognised corner injury is the commonest cause of graft failure.
Identify the peroneal nerve before working in the corner.
Consider reconstruction over repair in a chronic injury, since the lateral vascularity does not support the medial side's healing.
Plan the exposure for more than the inference says.
- Three structures give two findings, so the stage is an inference the exposure must exceed.
